environment: macOS 26 ARM64, Colima ARM64, disposable Docker volumes and synthetic process/lease fixtures
observations: Actual Docker acceptance passed for authenticated COM/dashboard health, service restart, shutdown, volume retention and negative startup. A disposable opted-in container denied maintenance with a running command and accepted prepare, commit and release when idle. The transaction rehearsal exercised busy deferral, copied-volume promotion, and recovery to the old container when candidate health failed. The connected local pilot used the verified main image and an independently authenticated staging tunnel. Candidate cutover and first scheduled live promotion are post-merge checks.
